phase_goal: deliver the first business-safe login and authenticated homepage loop
entry_conditions: user needs to open the internal web homepage from an unauthenticated browser state
one configured account is available for the first access loop
registration, password reset, persistent account management, and role authorization remain outside this phase
exit_conditions: anonymous homepage requests show the login entry and do not expose authenticated homepage content
valid configured credentials show the homepage with the signed-in user identity signal
invalid credentials keep the user unauthenticated and show a generic readable error
logout clears authenticated state and old-session homepage access returns to login
